modules.label: Parse GPS Sites
modules.note: JSON catalog → list[GPSLocation]. No LLM cost.

modules.label: Profile Each Location
modules.note: list[GPSLocation] → list[SiteProfile]. One structured LLM call per site.
modules.prompt: Profile this GPS site from its coordinates and notes. Infer country, region, nearest settlement, and climate zone from latitude/longitude. Set is_cold_location true for polar, subarctic, or routinely sub-zero climates. Guess facility_type_guess from the name and notes (research lab, military, industrial, logistics, etc.). Set is_likely_research_lab and is_russian_or_post_soviet from geography and context. Keep the same site_id and name as the input. Write a concise two-sentence profile_summary.

modules.label: Bundle Profiles
modules.note: list[SiteProfile] → ProfileCollection for the cross-site similarity step.

modules.label: Evaluate Similarities
modules.note: ProfileCollection → SimilarityReport (single object, not a list).
modules.prompt: Analyze all site profiles in profiles_json. Group sites into similarity_clusters — each entry should name the cluster, list member site_ids, and explain shared traits (e.g. Russian Arctic installations, polar research hubs, high-security western labs). Populate russian_site_ids, research_lab_site_ids, and cold_location_site_ids from the profiles. List notable_pairs of the most similar sites with a one-line rationale each. Write an executive_summary of the overall pattern. Return one SimilarityReport object, not an array.
